name: Underground Tunnels Beneath the White Tower
description: A chaotic mix of ancient, natural rock formations and the shattered, twisted remains of the Undercity's foundation beneath the White Tower. Heavy barricades of fused plasteel and crystalline rock block the path. Feral ghouls are swarming. The players must either secure the underground tunnels to get to safety before the blast doors close, or hold the doors and risk being overrun. Choices include breaching the doors and risking others, or rescuing trapped workers.
